pages.text: $(bold)Precision Spiral Rifling$()$(br2)Standard smoothbore barrels exhibit broad conical dispersion past thirty paces. To overcome this limitation, master armorers use Create mechanical drills to cut spiral rifling grooves into finished rifle barrels.

$(bold)Crafting the Rifled Barrel$()$(br2)Combine a reinforced long barrel with a Create Mechanical Drill and Precision Mechanism in a crafting bench to produce a $(6)Spiral Rifled Barrel$().$(br2)Assembling this barrel into a musket produces the prestigious $(6)FK15-R Jaeger Musket$().

$(bold)Ballistic Performance$()$(br2)The Jaeger musket imparts high spin stabilization to round balls, reducing dispersion by $(a)65%$().$(br2)While it demands disciplined loading, a marksman kneeling (Sneak) can reliably pick off commanders and officers across great distances.
